note: NECO Commerce round 4 (R49 top-up): purchase requisition; purchase order; goods received note; back order; bin card; shredder; office memo; grapevine; upward and downward communication; physical distribution; stock control; reorder level; lead time; buffer stock; EOQ; just-in-time; labour turnover; fringe benefits; invoice discounting; compulsory third-party insurance; offer and acceptance; poste restante; dry port; transit trade; functions of packaging. Scanned against the whole Commerce pool (JAMB, WAEC and NECO stems) and cleared of cross-subject twins.
